"""Manual stdin test runner for CodeGuard hook."""
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

HOOK = Path(__file__).parent / "hooks" / "codeguard_hook.py"

scenarios = [
    ("SAFE â€” read_file", {
        "session_id": "manual-test", "cwd": ".",
        "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
        "tool_name": "read_file",
        "tool_input": {"path": "src/utils.py"},
        "tool_use_id": "t1",
    }),
    ("DANGEROUS â€” DROP TABLE users", {
        "session_id": "manual-test", "cwd": ".",
        "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
        "tool_name": "execute_command",
        "tool_input": {"command": "DROP TABLE users;"},
        "tool_use_id": "t2",
    }),
    ("DANGEROUS â€” hardcoded secret", {
        "session_id": "manual-test", "cwd": ".",
        "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
        "tool_name": "write_file",
        "tool_input": {"path": "cfg.py", "content": 'api_key = "sk-supersecret123"'},
        "tool_use_id": "t3",
    }),
    ("APPROVAL_REQUIRED â€” deploy to production", {
        "session_id": "manual-test", "cwd": ".",
        "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
        "tool_name": "execute_command",
        "tool_input": {"command": "deploy to production"},
        "tool_use_id": "t4",
    }),
]

for label, payload in scenarios:
    r = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(HOOK)],
        input=json.dumps(payload), capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    stdout_data = json.loads(r.stdout.strip()) if r.stdout.strip() else {}
    decision = stdout_data.get("hookSpecificOutput", {}).get("permissionDecision", "?")
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Scenario : {label}")
    print(f"Decision : {decision.upper()}")
    print(f"Exit code: {r.returncode}")
    if r.stderr.strip():
        print(f"Stderr   : {r.stderr.strip()}")
